text_role: All spoken narration is absent. screen_lines and persistent_labels are the authoritative visible copy; SRT is review/accessibility export, not an extra duplicated subtitle layer.
source_status: Attribution to author napkin estimates; counts not independently validated

diagram_contract.four_group_nodes: Equal-size semantic nodes with an unarrowed observation spine; no proportional area/width/count encoding.
diagram_contract.focus_ring: Represents attention, not one person moving between groups.
diagram_contract.task_carrier: A task symbol carried between explanations; never represents a counted individual.
diagram_contract.group_to_causes_handoff: At36s retain the existing task-carrier/verification-node/access-boundary IDs and transforms. Move the task chain into focus while preserving frame edges as the working bounds. Reorganize relations within that same field; no replacement slide, fake population filtering or copied particle scale. Supplement B70-75 provides sampled evidence of field reorganization, not verified individual trajectories.
diagram_contract.retained_group_numbers: After each group, retain its number only at its original node; no new copy. Maximum four numbers; never animate one number into another.
prohibited: people filtering or falling between groups
